# RJL Fencing and Gates — Residential Fencing, Custom Gates & Automation

> Family-led residential fencing and gate specialists headquartered at Unit 1 / 12 Merchant Avenue, Thomastown VIC 3074, serving Melbourne’s north, north-east and north-west.

RJL Fencing and Gates is the residential division of the RJL Group. Services include timber and Colorbond boundary fencing, custom steel and timber-clad driveway gates, residential automation, pool safety barriers and retaining walls.

## Core Capabilities & Residential Specialities
- [Timber & Colorbond fencing](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/timber-colorbond-fencing-melbourne): Treated timber paling, capped and feature fencing, steel-post options and genuine Colorbond privacy boundaries.
- [Custom driveway gates](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/sliding-double-gates-bundoora): Made-to-measure sliding, double swing and pedestrian gates planned around slope, runback and access.
- [Residential automation](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/gate-automation-bundoora): Suitable motors, remotes, keypads, intercoms and compatible smartphone access, with site-specific safety checks.
- [Pool safety barriers](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/pool-fencing): Frameless glass, aluminium and batten barriers designed for the applicable Victorian standard. Owners arrange registration and formal inspection.
- [Retaining walls](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/retaining-walls): Concrete or timber sleeper systems and coordinated fence-on-wall packages, subject to drainage, engineering and approvals.
- [Gate servicing & maintenance](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/gate-servicing-maintenance): Assessment and servicing of suitable existing gate and automation systems.

## Homeowner Guidance
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/frequently-asked-questions): Neighbour fence costs, sliding versus swing gates, pool barriers, electrical bonding and service suburbs.
- [Victorian pool barrier guide](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/pool-fencing-regulations-victoria): Applicable standards, owner registration and independent inspection. Electrical bonding is assessed and carried out by a licensed electrician.
- [Neighbour fence-cost guide](https://www.rjlfencingandgates.com.au/blogs/neighbour-wont-pay-half-fence-victoria): Written quotes, agreement and the Victorian Fencing Notice process.
